terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: cd backend && SMARTROUTE_ENV=development APP_KEY=local-dev-app-key ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=local-dev-mock-anthropic-key AGENT_MOCK_MODE=1 AGENT_ALLOW_MEMORY_SESSIONS=1 .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: cd frontend && API_URL=http://localhost:8000 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:8000 APP_KEY=local-dev-app-key npm run dev
